content.short: Unicly is an NFT fractionalization protocol that allows users to tokenize and trade NFT collections with liquidity.
content.description: Unicly is a pioneering decentralized protocol designed to solve the problem of liquidity in the NFT market by enabling the combination and fractionalization of digital assets. The platform allows users to lock various NFTs—including high-value collectibles like CryptoPunks—into a vault and mint corresponding uTokens. These tokens represent fractional ownership of the entire collection, allowing them to be traded on automated market makers with high liquidity. Powered by the UNIC token, the protocol features a robust governance model where holders can vote on the reserve price.
content.meta: Unicly offers NFT fractionalization and liquidity tools, enabling users to tokenize digital collections. Discover Unicly on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
